items.title: Israeli strikes kill nine in Lebanon as Hezbollah fires rockets over border
items.description: The incidents strain a partial ceasefire agreed by Israel and the Lebanese armed group on Monday.

items.title: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
items.description: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit St Petersburg as Putin's flagship economic forum opens
items.description: Several long-range drones struck oil storage facilities near the city, days before Vladimir Putin is due to address the event.

items.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
items.description: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.

items.title: US announces new tariffs over forced labour concerns
items.description: It comes after the US Supreme Court struck down many of US President Donald Trump's previous duties in February.

items.title: Ex-UK political aide and Biden cabinet secretary lead California governor primary vote count
items.description: Another Democrat, billionaire climate activist Tom Steyer, is in third place as the tally continues.

items.title: Director Wim Wenders withdraws 1975 film over actress's teen topless scene
items.description: Nastassja Kinski, who appeared in the film when she was 13, said the film-maker "didn't protect me".

items.title: Four sentenced to death for killing worshippers at Catholic church in Nigeria
items.description: A fifth man was discharged and acquitted by the court due to insufficient evidence against him.

items.title: Norwegian teen was in UK to 'undertake a hit', court hears
items.description: Johannes Natland was due to carry out a shooting on behalf of a Swedish criminal group, trial hears.

items.title: Shell pumped oil through Nigeria pipeline for years despite pollution evidence, documents show
items.description: The oil giant says the documents ignore the critical context of the complex operating environment at the time.

items.title: Eight killed after drone hits bus in Russian-occupied part of Ukraine
items.description: The bus was hit in the eastern Donetsk region, an official says.

items.title: Man shot dead by FBI after taking hostages at California bank
items.description: Two hostages were released on Tuesday, and the remaining hostages released on Wednesday were unharmed, police said.
